status: measured 2026-11-03: 500 engine-vs-engine games on Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz
method: Colour-swapped opening pairs from tools/bench/openings.json; Bradley–Terry maximum likelihood, draws = ½, plus one virtual draw per match (keeps lopsided results finite); RD = sqrt(SE² + 40²).
anchor: Anchor: L1 Novice fixed at 800 (design choice; the absolute Crown scale is arbitrary and is not FIDE).
caveats: Engine-vs-engine strength only; no human games. L8 is time-limited (2 s cap in calibration) and therefore hardware dependent. Capped games are excluded. L9 Sovereign Max (v0.5) is a derived point: one 64-game match against L8 at time-scaled budgets, on one loaded 4-core host; its rating inherits L8's uncertainty.

levels.derived: v0.5: L8 rating + measured L9−L8 difference (+112 [60, 163], 64 games, 32 colour-swapped pairs, L9 3.33 s cap + 2^20 table vs L8 2 s cap; the in-game 10 s vs 6 s ratio at 1/3 scale). tools/bench/results/match-crown-L9-vs-crown-L8-v5max.json

matches.note: v0.5 time-scaled (3.33 s vs 2 s cap)
